sections.changelog:
Fixed

  • **Field auto-detection now finds tags that appear only on some offers.** A YML feed is sparse — optional tags such as `` and `` are present only on the offers that carry them, often far into the file. Column detection used to sample only the first offers and miss those tags, so they never appeared in the field-mapping dropdown and product descriptions and images could not be mapped. Detection now scans the whole feed (streamed, so memory stays flat and a typical feed scans in a few milliseconds), surfacing every field present anywhere in the file.
